## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The environment-variable default should be fixed because CI-configured exclusions are ignored. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
Adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` option that filters file names before archiving, logs skipped files, and includes documentation and tests.

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Honor ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE as the flag default — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE='*.log'` and no `--exclude`, you archive matching logs because the default is always `[]`. This violates `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11`: “Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment include files they intended to omit.
